title: Install/upgrade onboarding reconciliation is skipped for good when the community lease is busy
current: If the community-wide lease is held when the install or upgrade trigger runs, reconcileOnboardingForLifecycle returns { status: 'unchanged', reason: 'community_mutation_in_progress' }. onAppChanged reports only the status; the reason is dropped, and nothing retries the reconciliation until the next install or upgrade.
location: src/server/core/onboardingLifecycle.ts:99 (busy lease → unchanged); src/server/triggers/appChanged.ts:127 (status kept, reason discarded)
evidence: The posts-updater job takes the same lease every minute (R-S7-01), so an upgrade landing during a job run is a realistic collision. reportLifecycleOnboardingState receives reconciliationStatus but not reconciliation.reason.
assumptions: That the upgrade trigger isn't re-delivered by Devvit after a successful (200) response.
investigate: Log the reason with the lifecycle report.
Should a busy lease defer reconciliation to the next cron run instead of skipping it until the next upgrade?
Use the #237 lease timing logs to count how often upgrades collide with the cron.

criticality.why: An upgrade's onboarding reconciliation can be silently lost until the next release.
